Item 1A. Risk Factors

We identified a material weakness in our internal control over financial reporting related to access controls over our order-to-cash process during fiscal 2025.

We experienced a security incident in which an unauthorized party gained access to a subset of customer environment data; we notified affected customers and regulators as required.

We are a defendant in a putative securities class action related to statements made about our platform's reliability.

None.

Item 1C. Cybersecurity

Our board's audit committee oversees cybersecurity risk. Following the incident described above, we engaged a third-party firm to review our detection and response program and have since restated certain prior-period disclosures related to incident cost estimates.
